spec2def(ksecdd.sys ksecdd.spec)

include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/drivers/ksecdd)

# The 5 .c bodies replaced by Rust (ksecdd-rust). Kernel Security Support Provider.
# .c kept on disk (never-delete). Bar: link-clean x3.

add_registry_inf(ksecdd_reg.inf)

# ksecdd.sys is all Rust (ksecdd-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ksecdd-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
add_cargo_module(ksecdd ksecdd-cargo ksecdd.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE ksecdd-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
